places.name: Hat Creek herd camp near Lonesome Dove
places.note: Hands ready gear in the heat; Lippy is put over the horses; Call culls stock with Deets, names him scout, and keeps a mottled little bull.
places.location_hint: herd camp in the mesquite brush a couple of miles outside Lonesome Dove, south Texas border

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call wants bulls for stocking it; Augustus jokes Call could end up its governor passing laws against cattle thieves.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Most of the herd was taken from there, though the odd little bull wandered in on his own.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Augustus tells Ben Rainey it is the land of the northern lights.

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Call feels no fondness for the border country and wishes they had left long ago.

places.name: High Plains
places.note: Call longs for the dangerous open plains.
places.location_hint: open plains of north and west Texas and beyond

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus asks if Call isn't sorry to leave the place they pacified, and wonders how Xavier will manage.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande
